blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.39
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.39

blocks.text: चित्तस्थितिवच्छरीरकरणबाह्येषु
blocks.directed: [slowly] चित्तस्थितिवच्छरीरकरणबाह्येषु

blocks.text: Cittasthitivac charīrakaraṇabāhyeṣu.
blocks.directed: Cittasthitivac charīrakaraṇabāhyeṣu.

blocks.text: Just as in the states of mind, so too in the body, the senses and external objects.
blocks.directed: Just as in the states of mind, so too in the body, the senses and external objects.

blocks.text: Don’t Leave Your Enlightenment on the Meditation Cushion, You Absolute Muppet.
blocks.directed: Don’t Leave Your Enlightenment on the Meditation Cushion, You Absolute Muppet.

blocks.text: Now this is a beautiful continuation.
blocks.directed: Now this is a beautiful continuation.

blocks.text: And the Sanskrit is intentionally dependent upon the previous sūtra.
blocks.directed: And the Sanskrit is intentionally dependent upon the previous sūtra.

blocks.text: In other words, the phrase:
blocks.directed: [short pause] In other words, the phrase:

blocks.text: Tripadādyanuprāṇanam
blocks.directed: [slowly] Tripadādyanuprāṇanam

blocks.text: continues to govern the meaning.
blocks.directed: continues to govern the meaning.

blocks.text: The fourth should enliven the three states.
blocks.directed: The fourth should enliven the three states.

blocks.text: And that enlivening should extend beyond the mind into the body, senses and external manifestations.
blocks.directed: And that enlivening should extend beyond the mind into the body, senses and external manifestations.

blocks.text: Let’s unpack the compound.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack the compound.

blocks.text: Citta — mind.
blocks.directed: Citta — mind.

blocks.text: Sthiti — condition, state.
blocks.directed: Sthiti — condition, state.

blocks.text: Vat — like, as in.
blocks.directed: Vat — like, as in.

blocks.text: Śarīra — body.
blocks.directed: Śarīra — body.

blocks.text: Karaṇa — instrument; here, the sense faculties.
blocks.directed: Karaṇa — instrument; here, the sense faculties.

blocks.text: Bāhya — external objects.
blocks.directed: Bāhya — external objects.

blocks.text: So:
blocks.directed: [short pause] So:

blocks.text: As with mental states, so with the body, senses and the external world.
blocks.directed: As with mental states, so with the body, senses and the external world.

blocks.text: And here’s Kṣemarāja’s point.
blocks.directed: And here’s Kṣemarāja’s point.

blocks.text: It is not enough for the yogi to become established in recognition only during inward contemplation.
blocks.directed: It is not enough for the yogi to become established in recognition only during inward contemplation.

blocks.text: The same recognition must gradually extend throughout outward experience.
blocks.directed: The same recognition must gradually extend throughout outward experience.

blocks.text: Kramāt kramam.
blocks.directed: Kramāt kramam.

blocks.text: Step by step.
blocks.directed: Step by step.

blocks.text: Now that phrase is important.
blocks.directed: Now that phrase is important.

blocks.text: Because it tells us we’re dealing with a progressive integration.
blocks.directed: Because it tells us we’re dealing with a progressive integration.

blocks.text: The practitioner doesn’t simply announce:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The practitioner doesn’t simply announce:

blocks.text: “I have understood nonduality, therefore my entire life is now permanently liberated.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I have understood nonduality, therefore my entire life is now permanently liberated.”

blocks.text: That would be a rather bold claim.
blocks.directed: That would be a rather bold claim.

blocks.text: Especially if they immediately become furious about a delayed cup of tea.
blocks.directed: Especially if they immediately become furious about a delayed cup of tea.

blocks.text: Instead, the recognition cultivated inwardly is extended into ordinary embodied activity.
blocks.directed: Instead, the recognition cultivated inwardly is extended into ordinary embodied activity.

blocks.text: The body.
blocks.directed: The body.

blocks.text: The senses.
blocks.directed: The senses.

blocks.text: The appearances of the world.
blocks.directed: The appearances of the world.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja explicitly says this occurs through the power of sustained inward vimarśa.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja explicitly says this occurs through the power of sustained inward vimarśa.

blocks.text: The reflexive awareness of consciousness.
blocks.directed: The reflexive awareness of consciousness.

blocks.text: Now, think about the philosophical significance.
blocks.directed: Now, think about the philosophical significance.

blocks.text: At the beginning of Book III, the individual was bound through identification with the mind.
blocks.directed: At the beginning of Book III, the individual was bound through identification with the mind.

blocks.text: Then the tattvas were contemplated.
blocks.directed: Then the tattvas were contemplated.

blocks.text: The body became a field of practice.
blocks.directed: The body became a field of practice.

blocks.text: The senses became spectators of the cosmic drama.
blocks.directed: The senses became spectators of the cosmic drama.

blocks.text: And gradually the practitioner recognised the supreme conscious source.
blocks.directed: And gradually the practitioner recognised the supreme conscious source.

blocks.text: But now that recognition must become pervasive.
blocks.directed: But now that recognition must become pervasive.

blocks.text: The body isn’t to be regarded as a fundamentally alien obstacle.
blocks.directed: The body isn’t to be regarded as a fundamentally alien obstacle.

blocks.text: The senses aren’t fundamentally outside Śakti.
blocks.directed: The senses aren’t fundamentally outside Śakti.

blocks.text: And the external world isn’t an independent reality standing beyond the power of consciousness.
blocks.directed: And the external world isn’t an independent reality standing beyond the power of consciousness.

blocks.text: All become objects of contemplation within the same nondual understanding.
blocks.directed: All become objects of contemplation within the same nondual understanding.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja cites a verse from the Vijñānabhairava in which the practitioner is instructed to contemplate the entire universe, or their own body, as filled with the delight of the Self.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja cites a verse from the Vijñānabhairava in which the practitioner is instructed to contemplate the entire universe, or their own body, as filled with the delight of the Self.

blocks.text: And from that contemplative fullness, supreme bliss is said to arise. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: And from that contemplative fullness, supreme bliss is said to arise. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: Now imagine this in ordinary life.
blocks.directed: Now imagine this in ordinary life.

blocks.text: You’re walking down a road.
blocks.directed: You’re walking down a road.

blocks.text: Your legs are moving.
blocks.directed: Your legs are moving.

blocks.text: Your body is balancing.
blocks.directed: Your body is balancing.

blocks.text: Your senses are registering the environment.
blocks.directed: Your senses are registering the environment.

blocks.text: You hear footsteps.
blocks.directed: You hear footsteps.

blocks.text: Feel the ground.
blocks.directed: Feel the ground.

blocks.text: See the changing light.
blocks.directed: See the changing light.

blocks.text: Ordinarily, you might be entirely absorbed in these activities or in the thoughts accompanying them.
blocks.directed: Ordinarily, you might be entirely absorbed in these activities or in the thoughts accompanying them.

blocks.text: But the practitioner is invited to recognise the conscious reality through which the entire field of experience appears.
blocks.directed: But the practitioner is invited to recognise the conscious reality through which the entire field of experience appears.

blocks.text: Not merely the thoughts.
blocks.directed: Not merely the thoughts.

blocks.text: Not merely the inner state.
blocks.directed: Not merely the inner state.

blocks.text: The whole embodied manifestation.
blocks.directed: The whole embodied manifestation.

blocks.text: And here’s the important distinction.
blocks.directed: And here’s the important distinction.

blocks.text: This doesn’t require pretending that the body and world are physically identical.
blocks.directed: This doesn’t require pretending that the body and world are physically identical.

blocks.text: Nor does it mean a practitioner loses the ability to distinguish between themselves and other people.
blocks.directed: Nor does it mean a practitioner loses the ability to distinguish between themselves and other people.

blocks.text: The nondual claim concerns the ultimate conscious source of experience, not the elimination of every conventional distinction.
blocks.directed: The nondual claim concerns the ultimate conscious source of experience, not the elimination of every conventional distinction.

blocks.text: And the process is gradual.
blocks.directed: And the process is gradual.

blocks.text: The recognition first becomes clear inwardly.
blocks.directed: The recognition first becomes clear inwardly.

blocks.text: Then extends outward.
blocks.directed: Then extends outward.

blocks.text: And eventually, within the traditional ideal, the difference between inward absorption and outward engagement no longer obscures the supreme reality.
blocks.directed: And eventually, within the traditional ideal, the difference between inward absorption and outward engagement no longer obscures the supreme reality.

blocks.text: This is what makes the entire progression so extraordinary.
blocks.directed: This is what makes the entire progression so extraordinary.

blocks.text: The yogi begins by withdrawing attention from objects.
blocks.directed: The yogi begins by withdrawing attention from objects.

blocks.text: Then recognises the conscious source.
blocks.directed: Then recognises the conscious source.

blocks.text: Then returns to objects.
blocks.directed: Then returns to objects.

blocks.text: But now the objects are understood differently.
blocks.directed: But now the objects are understood differently.

blocks.text: The world hasn’t necessarily changed its outward appearance.
blocks.directed: The world hasn’t necessarily changed its outward appearance.

blocks.text: The standpoint has changed.
blocks.directed: The standpoint has changed.

blocks.text: And the experience of manifestation becomes inseparable from awareness of its source.
blocks.directed: And the experience of manifestation becomes inseparable from awareness of its source.

blocks.text: Now, after all this, you’d imagine the final six sūtras would simply conclude with congratulations.
blocks.directed: Now, after all this, you’d imagine the final six sūtras would simply conclude with congratulations.

blocks.text: Perhaps:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Perhaps:

blocks.text: “You’ve done it.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “You’ve done it.”

blocks.text: “Well done.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Well done.”

blocks.text: “Please collect your liberation certificate at reception.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Please collect your liberation certificate at reception.”

blocks.text: But no.
blocks.directed: But no.

blocks.text: Vasugupta is about to return to the bound individual.
blocks.directed: Vasugupta is about to return to the bound individual.

blocks.text: Again.
blocks.directed: Again.

blocks.text: Because one final problem remains.
blocks.directed: Because one final problem remains.

blocks.text: Desire.
blocks.directed: Desire.

blocks.text: The sense of incompleteness.
blocks.directed: The sense of incompleteness.

blocks.text: The movement of attention outward towards something imagined to provide fulfilment.
blocks.directed: The movement of attention outward towards something imagined to provide fulfilment.

blocks.text: And this is where the text becomes absolutely devastating.
blocks.directed: And this is where the text becomes absolutely devastating.

blocks.text: Because after discussing the highest states of recognition, it identifies a wonderfully ordinary mechanism through which consciousness becomes contracted again.
blocks.directed: Because after discussing the highest states of recognition, it identifies a wonderfully ordinary mechanism through which consciousness becomes contracted again.

blocks.text: Wanting.
blocks.directed: Wanting.

blocks.text: The little voice that says:
blocks.directed: [short pause] The little voice that says:

blocks.text: “I’ll be complete when I get that.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I’ll be complete when I get that.”

blocks.text: Oh dear.
blocks.directed: Oh dear.

blocks.text: Śiva has opened a shopping account.
blocks.directed: Śiva has opened a shopping account.
